gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: End-of-file marker returned by {@link Reader#read()} when no more characters are available.
ADDED i2: The maximum number of characters the {@link BoundedReader} is allowed to read from its target.
ADDED i3: Underlying reader with more characters than the bound, so the bound (not the data) ends the stream.
ADDED i4: Read one character first, so the mark is set at a non-zero offset.
ADDED i5: Mark with a read-ahead limit that, combined with the initial offset, points past MAX_CHARS.
ADDED i6: Read up to the bound: these two reads bring the total read count to MAX_CHARS.
ADDED i7: The bound is now reached, so any further read returns EOF.
